policy: Every value used by engine/ must come from this file. Entries with verified=false or value=null MUST be checked/filled during /kickoff from the cited (or a better) primary source. Never invent a source. Keep ranges honest.

who_aqg_pm25_24h.source: WHO Global Air Quality Guidelines (2021), PM2.5 24-hour guideline level

who_aqg_pm25_annual.source: WHO Global Air Quality Guidelines (2021), PM2.5 annual guideline level

cigarette_equiv_pm25_24h.source: Berkeley Earth (Muller & Muller, 2015) rough equivalence: 22 ug/m3 PM2.5 for 24h ~ 1 cigarette/day

naqi_pm25_breakpoints.source: CPCB National Air Quality Index (2014) PM2.5 sub-index breakpoints

grap_stage_aqi_thresholds.source: CAQM Graded Response Action Plan for Delhi-NCR (check latest revision)

inhalation_rate_daily_mean.source: US EPA Exposure Factors Handbook (2011), Chapter 6, Table 6-1 recommended long-term mean daily inhalation rates

activity_multiplier.source: Derived from EPA Exposure Factors Handbook (2011) Table 6-2 short-term rates by activity level; normalise so a typical day averages 1.0

indoor_penetration_factor.source: Indoor PM2.5 infiltration literature (e.g., Chen & Zhao 2011, Atmospheric Environment review)

indoor_deposition_rate.source: Indoor PM2.5 deposition literature (e.g., Chen & Zhao 2011)

air_exchange_closed.source: Typical residential air-exchange rates, windows closed (verify for Indian housing)

air_exchange_open.source: Typical residential air-exchange rates, windows open (verify)

infiltration_closed_building.source: Indoor/outdoor PM2.5 ratio studies, non-residential buildings without filtration (verify)

purifier_target_ach.source: Common sizing guidance for portable air cleaners in smoke/smog events (e.g., US EPA guide to air cleaners in the home) — verify

in_vehicle_ratio.source: Commuter exposure studies in Delhi/India by mode — research and cite during kickoff

indoor_source_emission_rate.source: Indoor source strength literature (cooking, incense, mosquito coils, candles, solid-fuel heating, smoking) — research and cite each during kickoff

emission_factor.source: India-relevant emission factors (e.g., ARAI / India GHG Program / IPCC / published inventories) — research and cite each during kickoff; keep kg_co2 and g_pm25 with ranges
